api.label: API ranking
api.description: AA's published cost to run the SDLC basket once at API rates: seven Intelligence Index SDLC evaluations, plus the Coding Agent Index where the ranking admits it.

plan.label: Plan ranking
plan.description: The basket's API cost divided by a subscription route's Value Multiple at full utilisation, one row per configuration and plan (O48); API cost when no route is admitted.

modelInclusion.frontierRule: Every model family on the Pareto frontier that Artificial Analysis (AA) renders on its Intelligence Index versus total cost to run chart is ranked at its highest point on that line (along the strictly rising line also its dearest). Frontier membership is AA's rendered line as observed; ValueRank never recomputes it from rounded values.
modelInclusion.nearFrontierRule: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when its public (rounded integer) Intelligence Index is within 3 points of the rendered frontier's Index at its cost, meaning the highest Index among rendered-frontier points that cost no more. Every near-frontier family is ranked or is explicitly deferred by a dated, reasoned roster decision. Every configuration AA plots on the frontier or within the gap is a cohort row (O51); a near family's primary configuration is its near point with the smallest Index gap. The cost ratio to the frontier is reported for information only.
modelInclusion.policyText: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when it lies within 3 Intelligence Index points of the rendered frontier at its cost. Every near-frontier model family must be in the primary ranking, with its own selected configuration, or be explicitly deferred with a dated, reasoned roster decision. The cost ratio to the cheapest frontier point of equal or higher intelligence is reported for information only.
